checks.name: Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity
Cook, staff and customer browser workflows against the real local stack (Playwright, Chromium), including reviews, favorites, moderation and basket replacement

scenarios.observed: ReviewsAndFavoritesIntegrationTest (PostgreSQL): review of a non-completed order 409, of another customer's order 404, ratings 0 and 6 422, second review of the same order 409; public list and kitchen/meal rating summaries contain only VISIBLE reviews and no order or customer data; hiding a review (content.moderate, reason, version) removes it from the list and the aggregate (3.5 -> 2.0); cook forbidden; audited. Browser journey: customer-b reviews the completed order in the customer web; a second submission after reload is refused by the server and exactly one review row exists; the moderator hides the reported review in the operations web and it disappears from the public meal page.

ReviewsAndFavoritesIntegrationTest: repeated PUT of a favorite keeps one row and DELETE is idempotent; a favorite whose meal is no longer public stays listed with available=false; a non-public meal cannot be added (404); another customer's order is 404 and anonymous access is 401 (private order link). Customer web: the account page lists unavailable favorites without a link (component test). Browser journey: the meal is favorited from the meal page (pressed state from the server list) and appears in the account page.

Browser journey on the real stack: order placed, cooked and completed; review once; meal page shows the visible rating summary and review; favorite and account page; report; moderator queue (API-098) shows the report count and hides it with a reason (audit row checked); order-again link opens the meal page so the next order is re-quoted at the current server price; basket replacement confirmation. Component tests: account page (profile with preferred language, favorites with unavailable marking, inbox, support cases, addresses, deletion request after explicit confirmation), meal-page favorite/report, order review form and order-again link, staff review queue sending the review version and reason. Integration test: moderation queue lists reported visible reviews with counts and reasons and hidden reviews with their reason, never reporter identities; cook and customer 403; invalid filter 422.

Browser journey: with a second synthetic OPEN slot of the same kitchen (test-only SQL), adding the meal for the other slot shows the replacement confirmation; choosing to keep the basket leaves the stored basket slot unchanged; confirming replaces it with the other slot. Component tests: a basket of another kitchen is kept on cancel and replaced (new kitchen, slot and single line) only on confirmation; no replacement is offered while a placement from the current basket is pending.

findings: Verified-order reviews, idempotent favorites and staff moderation exercised against PostgreSQL and in the browser.
Moderation queue exposes report counts and reasons only; no reporter identities.
Basket replacement now asks for confirmation (BR-018 client part, split from TC-018).

Residual: draft-to-approved visual restyle of the customer screens to the terracotta homepage hierarchy is pending (tokens and Cairo applied); dark palette unreviewed; deletion uses the draft retention policy version.
